mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, user_id, preference_key, preference_json::text AS preference_json_text, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at FROM iam_user_preference WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND preference_key = #{preferenceKey} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_user_preference ( tenant_id, user_id, preference_key, preference_json, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{preference.tenantId}, #{preference.userId}, #{preference.preferenceKey}, CAST(#{preference.preferenceJson} AS jsonb), #{preference.createdBy}, #{preference.createdAt}, #{preference.updatedBy}, #{preference.updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, user_id, preference_key) DO UPDATE SET preference_json = EXCLUDED.preference_json, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
